set.body: Implement dependency-free sirin-graphics on JVM and Scala Native: Double geometry and affine transforms, immutable paths/paints/strokes, ordered drawing commands with scoped transforms/clips/isolated opacity, drawing reuse and instances. Document provisional contracts/module boundaries and demonstrate standalone authoring. Add meaningful contract tests and include graphics in testJVM/testNative. No GPU renderer, native bindings, image/font handles or UI/kernel changes in this slice; graphics/backend qualification remains open.
set.title: G-0/G-1: Standalone vector drawing and recording foundation
